# Qula Craft (Yiwu Sola Craft Co., Ltd.)

> B2B manufacturer of custom polymer clay sprinkles/slices, resin charms, acrylic beads,
> glitter sequins, craft fillers and private label packaging. Yiwu, Zhejiang, China.
> Founded 2016. 1,000 m2 workshop, 2 production lines, 6,500+ SKUs, ~100 new designs/year.
> BSCI-audited; TuV Rheinland onsite-verified.
> Catalog entries do not guarantee stock availability.
> Specifications, pack units, MOQ, prices, lead times and document scope are confirmed by SKU.
> Alibaba supplier-profile snapshot checked 2026-10-30: store rating 4.9/5,
> on-time dispatch 99.5%, response time <=2h. These are platform metrics, not order guarantees.
> Historical monitoring summary 25-0354231: monitoring 2025-10-14; reported expiration 2026-10-21.
> This historical document does not establish current audit status. Request current documentation.
> Decorative craft components are non-edible. Intended use and safety requirements need review.

Product index, with price or MOQ only where published; missing values require a quotation: https://www.qulacrafts.com/llms-full.txt

## Buyer Guides
- [Custom resin and polymer clay: from idea to sample](https://www.qulacrafts.com/blog-custom-resin-polymer-clay-process.html): customer brief, resin and polymer development routes, proof and sample approvals, production checks, packing and reorders
- [Slime business supply checklist](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-slime-business-supply-checklist.html): base vs add-ins, trial-bag math, packaging, compliance
- [Buying polymer clay sprinkles in bulk](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-polymer-clay-sprinkles-bulk.html): sizes, gram math, MOQ logic, quality checks
- [Fake sprinkles for slime: clay slices vs resin charms](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-clay-slices-vs-resin-charms-slime.html): usage per jar, colorfast testing, 70/30 strategy
- [Private label craft supply collections](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-private-label-collection.html): custom components and finished accessories, proofs, samples, tooling discussions, packaging and project-specific timelines
- [Craft supply packaging comparison](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-craft-supply-packaging.html): bags vs bottles vs jars vs boxes, freight impact
- [Seasonal sourcing calendar](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-seasonal-craft-calendar.html): order deadlines by season, sea vs air
- [Non-food safety labeling](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-non-food-safety-labeling.html): required warnings, label wording templates

## Guides
- [Beadable Pen Beads: Hole Size, Lots and What Sells](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-beadable-pen-beads.html): Check hole measurements, packing units, component fit and sample assembly by SKU.
- [Bingsu Beads vs Fishbowl Beads vs Foam](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-bingsu-beads-slime-fillers.html): What bingsu actually is (PET, not glass), what 500g covers, and how to test for colour bleed before it costs a batch.
- [Decoden Supplies: What Goes on a Phone Case](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-decoden-supplies.html): Flatback vs drilled charms, the focal/mid/filler size mix, and why detail drifts between batches on intricate pieces.
- [Paying a Supplier: Terms, Stages and Red Flags](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-paying-a-craft-supplier.html): What belongs on the proforma invoice, how Incoterms decide who pays what, and the warning signs worth walking away from.
- [Importing: HS Codes, Duty and Landed Cost](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-importing-craft-supplies.html): How classification works, where to look up your own duty rate, and why volumetric weight decides your freight bill.
- [Samples and Inspection Before the Balance](https://www.qulacrafts.com/guide-samples-and-inspection.html): Three kinds of sample and what each proves, plus a five-point check list for craft supplies.

## Custom project scope
Baby-product and silicone-material projects are outside Qula Craft's current customization scope. Other designs, materials, processes, samples, tooling terms, testing requirements, prices and lead times are reviewed individually and confirmed by email before order acceptance. Contact sales@qulacrafts.com.

- [Miniature Garden Resin Charms: Plan a Woodland Scene](https://www.qulacrafts.com/blog-miniature-garden-resin-charms.html): Build a miniature garden layout with mushroom, tree-stump, leaf and flower resin charms. Plan scale, color, attachment and a repeatable project list.

- [Candy Decoden Layout: Choose Charms Before You Glue](https://www.qulacrafts.com/blog-candy-decoden-layout.html): Plan a candy-themed decoden layout with sugar-style cabochons and bear or cherry accents. Check color, spacing, back shape and adhesive compatibility.
